expire.a: Daily free credits reset every day, the welcome bonus lasts 30 days, subscription credits last until the end of the billing month and purchased credits for 12 months. We always spend the credits that expire soonest first.

models.q: Does a more thorough analysis cost more?
models.a: No. Every file gets the full analysis for its type and costs the same flat price.

refund.a: Unused purchased credits can be refunded within 30 days of purchase, pro-rata. Subscriptions are fully refundable within 7 days if unused, otherwise pro-rata. Bonus and free credits are not refundable. See the refund policy for details.

payment.a: Korean cards and easy-pay services through Toss Payments (KRW), and international cards through Stripe (USD). We never see or store your card details.

api.a: Yes. Every registered account can create API keys. API calls use the same credits as the web app.

enterprise.q: Do you offer enterprise or on-premise plans?
enterprise.a: Yes — contact us for invoiced billing, higher limits, dedicated GPUs or on-premise deployment.
